name: Angelicin
summary: Angelicin is the parent compound in a family of naturally occurring organic compounds known as the angular furanocoumarins. Structurally, it can be considered as benzapyra-2-one fused with a furan moiety in the 7,8-position. Angelicin is commonly found in certain Apiaceae and Fabaceae plant species such as Bituminaria bituminosa.46. The maximum absorption is observed at 300 nm.

uses.text: Angelicin derivatives are used to treat psoriasis and cancer. One way of treating these diseases is by photochemotherapy (PUVA) which combines UV irradiation with photosensitizing chemical. In most cases the 4,5’-dimethylangelicin is applied owing to its firm binding and specificity to DNA. Also, it was shown that it is actively inhibits the synthesis of nucleic acids in tumor cells thereby decreasing their growth.

summaryZh: 白芷素是呋喃香豆素的一種，分子式C11H6O3，存在於歐白芷根部提取物精油中。由德國藥學家布克納於1842年發現。

pharmacology.en: It absorbs ultraviolet light and, once excited, binds to DNA. This is used on purpose in light therapy for skin disease, where the light and the chemical together slow the overgrowth of skin cells.
pharmacology.zh: 它會吸收紫外光，受激發後與 DNA 結合。皮膚病的光療便刻意利用這一點，讓光與藥物共同減緩皮膚細胞的過度增生。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它会吸收紫外光，受激发后与 DNA 结合。皮肤病的光疗便刻意利用这一点，让光与药物共同减缓皮肤细胞的过度增生。

sideEffects.en: It makes skin highly sensitive to sunlight, so contact followed by sun can cause redness, blistering and burns, and lasting dark patches. Because it binds DNA, light therapy with these compounds raises the long-term risk of skin cancer.
sideEffects.zh: 它會使皮膚對陽光高度敏感，接觸後曝曬可能造成紅腫、起泡、灼傷與持久的色素斑。由於它會與 DNA 結合，使用這類化合物的光療會提高長期皮膚癌風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会使皮肤对阳光高度敏感，接触后曝晒可能造成红肿、起泡、灼伤与持久的色素斑。由于它会与 DNA 结合，使用这类化合物的光疗会提高长期皮肤癌风险。

fact.en: It is named after Angelica, the plant it was found in, and belongs to the furanocoumarins. These are the compounds that make some plants, such as giant hogweed, cause burns when the skin is then exposed to sunlight.
fact.zh: 白芷素以其來源植物當歸屬（Angelica）命名，屬於呋喃香豆素類。正是這類化合物使某些植物，例如大豬草，在皮膚接觸後曝曬陽光時造成灼傷。
fact.zhHans: 白芷素以其来源植物当归属（Angelica）命名，属于呋喃香豆素类。正是这类化合物使某些植物，例如大猪草，在皮肤接触后曝晒阳光时造成灼伤。
